how: Add diagnostics and programmatic checks in SLDB, then let deskops consume those outputs rather than re-implementing the logic.
how_not: Do not make deskops parse raw store internals or duplicate validity rules that belong in SLDB.
title: Store health is owned by SLDB
what: SLDB, not deskops, should define and expose what counts as a valid `.sldb/` store.
when: Apply this pill when adding health checks, integrity commands, diagnostics, or recovery-related CLI/API surfaces.
where:
- `src/sldb/store/`
- `src/sldb/cli/commands/stores.py`
- downstream deskops health surfaces that call into SLDB
why: Only SLDB knows the internal store contracts. Duplicating validation logic downstream would create drift and inconsistent recovery behavior.
